description.text: When to apply early March – early April Admission Upon acceptance, the University will send the "Notification of Admission to Peking University” and "Visa Application Form for Foreigners" (Form JW202) by the end of June. Registration Period September (the date of registration will be specified in the “Notification of Admission to Peking University”). Tuition fee and Housing fees 1. Tuition Fee: 26,000 RMB per year per person (teaching materials are not included), which must be paid in full on the day of registration. 2. Housing fees: Peking University provides students with accommodation in the Posts and Telecommunications Hotel, located 500 meters west of the main campus. Apartments: 58 RMB per day per bed. Two- or three-room apartment with two beds in each room, equipped with air conditioner, color TV, telephone, bathroom, and room-cleaning service. Single room: 95R MB per day per room.

duration.text: The Pre-University Program at Peking University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 300 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. Letter from financial guarantor indicating his or her name, profession, telephone number, and contact address 8. Letter from sponsor in China indicating his or her name, working unit, telephone number, and permanent address

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens; 2. Between the ages of 18 and 60 (18 and 60 included); 3. Healthy; 4. With educational background of or above high school graduation;
